mission.title: Our mission
mission.quote1: At Illi, our mission is to share products we truly love, made with quality ingredients, in step with the seasons and with respect for living food, while passing on a simple, authentic way of taking care of yourself.
mission.quote2: To nourish everyday life with simple, living foods made with care, while passing on our know-how from mother to daughter.

story.metaDescription: Illi was born in a mother's kitchen: a story of fermentation, homemade food and know-how passed from mother to daughter.
story.lead: Illi was born in my mother's kitchen.
part1: A few years ago, she felt the need to take care of herself differently. She became interested in living foods, in fermentation, and in the simple preparations you make yourself, with patience and good ingredients.
Little by little, she created her own recipes, her own habits and, above all, a new way of eating — simpler and more mindful.
Then I started tasting everything she made.

And without really noticing, I made these foods part of my everyday life. Simply because I loved them: for their taste, their simplicity, that feeling of coming back to the essentials, and for the good they do.
One day we asked ourselves: why keep all this to ourselves?
part2: And so Illi was born: an idea imagined by my mother, which I discovered and adopted, and which today we want to build together.
story.heading2: With Illi, we want to share much more than products.
part3: We want to pass on a way of making things, and also a way of taking care of yourself: choosing quality ingredients, favouring organic and seasonal produce, taking the time to do things, and rediscovering the pleasure of homemade food.
Because behind every recipe there is know-how.
And behind that know-how, a story, gestures, habits and a way of living that we want to share.
story.heading3: Illi is our story, from mother to daughter.
part4: Recipes passed down, tastes shared, and the wish to introduce you to what we truly love.
Simple things, made at home, with a lot of care.
And above all, the wish to bring something good, real and positive into the daily lives of those who trust us.
story.signature: Illi, from our kitchen to yours.
